english.note: Choose this for a powerful visual or emotional impact, whether the scene is beautiful or the event is shocking.
Use this when the striking effect is emotionally powerful or shocking rather than merely grand-looking.
Use this when the thing makes a particularly powerful emotional or visual impact.
Use this for a spectacular sight or event that has a powerful emotional impact.
Use this for a powerful, deeply shocking impact rather than an ordinary surprise.
Use this when the thing is awe-inspiring or emotionally powerful, not merely large or good.
Use this when an impressive sight or experience is awe-inspiring or emotionally overwhelming rather than simply excellent.
